companyIntro.name: Nova Retail Group
companyIntro.mission: Run stores and online shops that customers return to and shareholders can rely on.
companyIntro.culture: Numbers on Monday, action by Tuesday. Every KPI has an owner and a weekly review.

projectBackground.name: Store Network Refresh — Riverside Store
projectBackground.context: Riverside is under its profit target. Head office wants to know where the money leaks.

manager.name: Claire Whitfield
manager.note: Numbers on Monday, action by Tuesday. Tell me the KPI, the cause and your fix.

assignment.title: Find the leaks in the store
assignment.brief: Calculate sales per m², labour %, shrinkage, check departments in Excel and write the weekly report.

documents.name: Store Data
documents.note: Sales €900,000 over 600 m²; labour €108,000; stock loss 2.4% of sales.

documents.name: Department Table
documents.note: Three departments with sales and labour.

documents.name: Rota
documents.note: Peak hours understaffed; quiet hours overstaffed.

tasks.title: Sales Density
tasks.prompt: Sales €900,000 over 600 m². What is sales per m² (€)?
tasks.mistake: Comparing total sales of different-sized stores misleads.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Labour Cost %
tasks.prompt: Labour cost €108,000 on sales €900,000. What is labour % of sales?
tasks.mistake: Cutting hours at peak loses sales.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Shrinkage Loss
tasks.prompt: Stock loss is 2.4% of €900,000 sales. What is the loss (€)?
tasks.tip: Split by cause: theft, error, damage.
tasks.mistake: Treating shrink as unavoidable hides fixable causes.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Reducing Shrink
tasks.mistake: Skipping checks lets errors become losses.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Department Labour % (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Labour % in column D = C / B x 100.
tasks.tip: Check the rota for that department.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Weekly Report
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence weekly report to head office.
tasks.modelAnswer: Sales were €900,000, €1,500 per m², with labour at 12% of sales. Shrinkage cost €21,600 (2.4%); we are adding cycle counts on electronics and a receiving check. Apparel labour is 16% against 11% in grocery, so I am moving two hours from quiet mornings to Saturday peak. I will report the impact next Monday.
tasks.reasoning: A good report gives KPIs, causes and actions.
tasks.mistake: Numbers without actions are just history.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Quiet Leak
caseStudy.background: A store lost 3.5% of sales to shrink for a year. Most of it was supplier delivery errors never checked at receiving.
caseStudy.solution: Nova introduced blind receiving counts and weekly variance reports.

prompts: Which KPI would you watch daily?
How do you schedule for peaks?
How do you talk to staff about shrink?
